name: SLICE
desc: Array/string spans; positive and negative positional forms; range-object derivation, computed fields and reference paths; Unicode codepoint boundaries and flagged lone-surrogate cases; copying, SPLIT metadata, pending edits, numeric IDs, malformed syntax, invalid targets and operands, and match-context error handling. Literal operand faults and intrinsically impossible ranges permit stronger static diagnoses.

tests.name: Array offset and count
tests.desc: Positive, negative, omitted, and zero counts select the specified span.

tests.name: Array range objects
tests.desc: Derive a span from consistent ofs, len, and lim fields.

tests.name: Invalid array spans
tests.desc: Out-of-bounds or ill-typed literal spans must fail.

tests.name: String offset and count
tests.desc: String spans use the same normalization rules as array spans.

tests.name: String range objects
tests.desc: Range objects select string spans using logical character positions.

tests.name: Invalid string spans
tests.desc: Out-of-bounds or ill-typed literal string spans must fail.

tests.name: Empty operands
tests.desc: Empty spans and ranges are valid at the empty array or string boundary.

tests.name: Unicode boundaries
tests.desc: Whole spans, individual elements, and negative indices use codepoint boundaries, including supported lone surrogates.

tests.name: Computed operands and paths
tests.desc: Numeric identifiers, constructed values, references, and range paths preserve literal data and codepoint indexing.
